summary.interpretation: pct_exactness_satisfied is the fraction of hard-FEASIBLE steps on which slack_weight_lin exceeds ||lambda*||_inf, i.e. on which the l1 penalty is exact and the soft QP is returning the hard solution. max_u0_soft_minus_hard_degC is the realised discrepancy on the APPLIED move. A non-zero value on an exact step is attributable to the quadratic slack term, which is never exact at finite weight.
